-- DuckDB: a list of structs, and unnest() makes rows
CREATE TABLE tickets AS FROM (VALUES
    (1, 'Maria Chen joined Northwind Freight, a company in Chicago.')) t(id, body);
SELECT id, unnest(thinkthen_recognize(body,
    ['person', 'organization', 'place'])) AS name FROM tickets;
-- 1 | Maria Chen | person
-- 1 | Northwind Freight | organization
-- 1 | Chicago | place
SELECT * FROM thinkthen_relations((SELECT body FROM tickets), '@names.json');
-- works_for | 1 | 2
-- based_in | 2 | 3
